references.text: The pillar of cloud came down and stood at the entrance to the tent when the Lord spoke with Moses, just as here in Num 12:5
The Lord came down in the cloud and stood beside Moses, a parallel to how the Lord comes down in the pillar of cloud
The cloud covered the tent of meeting and the glory of the Lord filled the tabernacle, showing the connection between the pillar of cloud and God's presence
The Lord appeared in the tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood at the entrance to the tent
God spoke to them in the pillar of cloud, confirming the pillar of cloud as a medium for divine communication
The Lord went before the people in a pillar of cloud by day, showing the role of the pillar of cloud as a sign of God's guidance and presence
The Lord came down in the cloud and spoke to Moses, a similar theophany where the cloud marks God's presence
